info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Interface — Service, IoT & Specialty
info.description:
Service, IoT and specialty interface configuration.

**Types covered (15):** AppNav-Compress, AppNav-UnCompress, Embedded-Service-Engine, Service-Engine, ucse, Ethernet-Internal, Wlan-GigabitEthernet, SM, GMPLS, PRP-channel, Bundle, LORAWAN, WPAN, Virtual-WPAN, vmi

**Common use cases:** WAAS AppNav optimization, UCS-E blade, LoRaWAN IoT gateway, WPAN mesh, PRP industrial redundancy

**YANG:** Cisco-IOS-XE-native interface container + augments from nam, policy, etc.

get.description:
Retrieve all AppNav-Compress interface configurations.

CLI equivalent: `show running-config | section interface AppNav-Compress`

Returns a list of AppNav-Compress interfaces with their name (key), IP addressing, shutdown state, description, and augmented features (QoS service-policy, ACL bindings, etc.).

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Limit the depth of returned sub-tree data (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.2). Use 'unbounded' for full depth.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Select specific fields to return (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.3). Example: fields=name;status

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Filter by config state: 'config' (config true only), 'nonconfig' (config false only), or 'all'.

patch.description: Merge update to AppNav-Compress interface configurations.
